title: Anthropic Launches Claude for Manufacturing With 17 Factory Skills
dek: A new plugin drafts quotes and quality reports, with a human sign-off.

facts.label: Manufacturers still entering data by hand

caption:
Anthropic just walked onto the factory floor, and it's starting with the paperwork 🏭

Claude for Manufacturing is a new plugin for Claude Team and Enterprise plans. It bundles 17 skills that draft quotes, investigate failed inspections, diagnose breakdowns, compare supplier bids and compile production reports. Connectors for Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365 and Oracle NetSuite let Claude pull from the records plants already keep.

The key detail: every job stops for human review. Claude drafts and links its evidence, while an estimator releases the quote and a quality engineer verifies the fix. Infor is also shipping its own plugin that can make changes inside Infor, limited by user permissions.

We're tracking how AI moves into industry at AI Parabellum. Would you trust AI to draft your next quote?
